entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will support the new Constitutio..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will support the new Constitution."
entries.menuText: "I will support the new Constitution."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""That's great to hear, Mr. Presiden..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's great to hear, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Most people find the Supreme Court..."
entries.dialogueText: "Most people find the Supreme Court's absolute authority over constitutional changes dangerous. Look at the situation we currently have, Mr. President. The Judiciary has power over every branch."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""We will be ensuring that there won..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will be ensuring that there won't be another politically motivated Supreme Court."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""If we can fully reach an agreement..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we can fully reach an agreement with the reformists, we will be very strong in the Assembly to propose the change."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Glad to hear it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Glad to hear it."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Yes. This will ensure that there w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. This will ensure that there won't be another politically motivated Supreme Court."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That's why the Old Guard have barg..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's why the Old Guard have bargaining chips over us."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We can't just bribe the Old Guards..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't just bribe the Old Guards. Judge Garaci and the Chief Justice Hawker will do their best to undermine us."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Most of them won't. But we already..."
entries.dialogueText: "Most of them won't. But we already talked about my vote and a possible agreement with Isabel which may change things."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Now we have a better picture of yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now we have a better picture of your intentions, sir. I will start reaching out to my contacts to make a draft that works for us."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Well, regardless of what Mr. Rayne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, regardless of what Mr. Rayne decides, we will need to work together to push this agenda."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I'll present your input to the com..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll present your input to the committee. In a few months, you would have the draft on your desk to make the final changes yourself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will eventually remove his last..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will eventually remove his lasting influence."
entries.menuText: "We will eventually remove his influence."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""We'll need to break the power of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll need to break the power of the Old Guard within USP first. Most of the conservative wing are still loyal to their Colonel."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Now we should wrap this up. Since..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now we should wrap this up. Since we evaluated the points, I'd like to hear your input, sir."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""This is yet another point that was..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is yet another point that was unanimously agreed on by all parties. Tarquin Soll established this rule to protect his '29 Constitution. We all know most of the judges are still his pawns."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I won't support these reforms. We'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't support these reforms. We'll work with the Old Guard to block them."
entries.menuText: "I won't support these reforms. We'll work with the Old Guard to block them."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Can we reach a two-thirds majority..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can we reach a two-thirds majority in the Assembly?"
entries.menuText: "Can we reach a two-thirds majority in the Assembly?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How many votes do they have in tot..."
entries.dialogueText: "How many votes do they have in total?"
entries.menuText: "How many votes do they have?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Jump to: [BackToAutocrat]

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Even though Mr. Ricter put on a wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even though Mr. Ricter put on a whole show about why vetoes should completely be removed, the committee has almost unanimously agreed on fixing the loopholes, thus limiting presidential vetoes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Is it possible to pass this throug..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is it possible to pass this through the Supreme Court?"
entries.menuText: "Is it possible to pass the Supreme Court?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: BaseGame.Reform_Autocrat_Intention = false

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm sure the rest can be bribed.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure the rest can be bribed."
entries.menuText: "I'm sure the rest can be bribed."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""If you can get Frens Ricter to wor..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you can get Frens Ricter to work with you on this, our only problem would be uniting our own party. We'll never be able to get NFP to work with us."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Apart from these two critical poin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apart from these two critical points they have other major demands."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Reformist Branch Start

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Who else would be willing to suppo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who else would be willing to support reforms?"
entries.menuText: "Who else would be willing to support reforms?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""They are the biggest obstacle. Eve..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are the biggest obstacle. Even if we pass the Assembly, the Chief Justice will do his best to block our amendments."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So, we only have 3 votes out of 11?""
entries.dialogueText: "So, we only have 3 votes out of 11?"
entries.menuText: "So, we only have 3 votes out of 11?"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""They want to reform the appointmen..."
entries.dialogueText: "They want to reform the appointment procedures of the ministers. Mr. Ricter clarified that the Assembly should have a say in the formation of the council of ministers."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Well, Mr. Ricter also talked about..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Mr. Ricter also talked about abolishing the Member of Honor rights of Tarquin Soll that gives him absolute immunity and makes him a permanent member of the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That is something that a majority..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is something that a majority in our party also supports."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I'm sure it's possible. But regard..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure it's possible. But regardless of my opinion, we *need* to persuade most of them to support us for passing an amendment to the Constitution."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Well... That one is a controversia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well... That one is a controversial one. I doubt that USP would like that."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The conservatives have around 40 s..."
entries.dialogueText: "The conservatives have around 40 seats. There are many unaligned people and some of your "loyalists" might decide to show their true faces too."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Immunity of the Justices, the impe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Immunity of the Justices, the impeachment of the president, limiting the power of the presidential decrees... All of this came up during the committee meetings."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you really think they can be pe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you really think they can be persuaded?"
entries.menuText: "Do you think they can be persuaded?"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Yes, reformists expect big reforms..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, reformists expect big reforms while our faction in the USP are not very keen on pushing changes that are too great."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We did it before for the elections..."
entries.dialogueText: "We did it before for the elections. We can do it again."
entries.menuText: "We did it before for the elections. We can do it again."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I'd say keeping everything in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd say keeping everything in the middle ground is the safest bet. No need to agitate anyone too much."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's go through the draft details.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's go through the draft details."
entries.menuText: "Let's go through the draft."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I disagree. We'll push for compreh..."
entries.dialogueText: "I disagree. We'll push for comprehensive reforms."
entries.menuText: "I disagree. We'll push for comprehensive reforms."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""But we might try and bribe the cen..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we might try and bribe the centrists of the Court. I think we might get Mr. Dalton and Mr. Martin with a bribe. The toughest will be Mrs. Edmonds."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I agree. Let's keep the changes sm..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. Let's keep the changes small and manageable."
entries.menuText: "I agree. Let's keep the changes small and manageable."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Two of the judges are friends of m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Two of the judges are friends of mine, and of similar opinion about the reforms. Consider them with me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They have valid concerns that we n..."
entries.dialogueText: "They have valid concerns that we need to look at."
entries.menuText: "They have valid concerns that we need to look at."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We should reach out to the judges..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should reach out to the judges in secret. Some of them might be willing to break rank to support us."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I'm with you on this, Mr. Presiden..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm with you on this, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We need at least 6 of the 11 judge..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need at least 6 of the 11 judges to vote for the proposal. But Mr. Hawker has enormous influence over the judges."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""As long as we address the main iss..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as we address the main issues, I also agree."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: BaseGameIsolated.Turn02_A_Reforms_Listened_KeyFigure02 = true

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I'll keep working with them and ke..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll keep working with them and keep you updated, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""But it will be tough to unite the..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it will be tough to unite the USP with all the divisive wings that have formed. You must make them follow you loyally."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We need the majority of our 130 se..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need the majority of our 130 seats in the Assembly to vote in favour. With PFJP's full support of 70 votes, we will easily surpass the needed 166."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What are the final demands?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are the final demands?"
entries.menuText: "What are the demands?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They will not be allowed to dictat..."
entries.dialogueText: "They will not be allowed to dictate the negotiations."
entries.menuText: "They will not be allowed to dictate the negotiations."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Albin Clavin and his reformist win..."
entries.dialogueText: "Albin Clavin and his reformist wing would be supporting you. He already weighed in heavily in the committee meetings."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Constitutional amendments will sti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Constitutional amendments will still be very difficult to accomplish with a reform like this, particularly because we will keep the two-thirds vote system to be able to propose a change. However, the judiciary will not have the final say in the amendments."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I think Judge Edmonds can be persu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think Judge Edmonds can be persuaded. And in extension, Mr. Dalton and Mr. Martin."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This is already what our administr..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is already what our administration wanted to do."
entries.menuText: "This is already what we wanted to do."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""However, the conservatives would b..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, the conservatives would be tough to break. The influence of Soll is still living strong in the party."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can't disagree with that stateme..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't disagree with that statement."
entries.menuText: "I can't disagree with that."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""They weren't really blinded by the..."
entries.dialogueText: "They weren't really blinded by the Sollist ideology."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And what good does that do to us?""
entries.dialogueText: "And what good does that do to us?"
entries.menuText: "And what good does that do to us?"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Three votes, yes. But I believe th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Three votes, yes. But I believe that Judge Edmonds can be persuaded as well. She and two other judges, Mr. Dalton and Mr. Martin."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We'll go through each of the main..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll go through each of the main demands of the committee, and get your input. Mrs. Morgna can explain them further."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The loopholes give the President t..."
entries.dialogueText: "The loopholes give the President too much power which could be misused."
entries.menuText: "The loopholes give the President too much power."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We'll start with the first *red li..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll start with the first *red line*. The new Constitution will fix the loopholes regarding the president's absolute veto powers."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We need the Court to even pass thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need the Court to even pass this change. Why on earth would they support this?"
entries.menuText: "We need the Court to even pass this change. Why would they support this?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will convince the leads.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will convince the leads."
entries.menuText: "We will convince the leads."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""My suggestion is to add a clause d..."
entries.dialogueText: "My suggestion is to add a clause detailing the methods the Assembly may override a veto with some sort of a super-majority. One person should never be able to block the rest."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""So we need as many of the conserva..."
entries.dialogueText: "So we need as many of the conservatives to support us. And there is only one person who is key to make them back us."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Jump to: [ReformistKeyFigureHub]

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They will surely support a just ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "They will surely support a just cause for the country and its future."
entries.menuText: "They will surely support a just cause for the country and its future."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""All means are to be considered in..."
entries.dialogueText: "All means are to be considered in order to succeed."
entries.menuText: "All means are to be considered in order to succeed."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: BaseGameIsolated.Turn02_A_Reforms_Listened_KeyFigure01 = true

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia was taken aback by the statemen..."
entries.dialogueText: Nia was taken aback by the statement.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The second one is about the judici..."
entries.dialogueText: "The second one is about the judiciary. The new Constitution will remove the Supreme Court's right to vote on legislation."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""And there is only one person who i..."
entries.dialogueText: "And there is only one person who is key to make them back us."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""According to the Constitution, I a..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to the Constitution, I am a member of the Supreme Court, which means we already have one vote."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We should run-down each of the mai..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should run-down each of the main demands of the committee, and get your input first. Mrs. Morgna can explain them further."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I don't think this is up to discus..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think this is up to discussion for any reformists."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I also have reasons to think she m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I also have reasons to think she might be in Orso's pocket. She will be tough to break, but we'll need her help to get the conservative support."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yes, those three don't seem to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, those three don't seem to be working directly with the Chief Justice Hawker. If we can get to Isabel Edmonds, we might get the 6 votes needed. That's our best bet."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yes, we'll need to talk to Judge E..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we'll need to talk to Judge Edmonds. If we can get to her, we might get the 6 votes needed. That's our best bet."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I stand in agreement with Mr. Rict..."
entries.dialogueText: "I stand in agreement with Mr. Ricter. The vetoes should be removed altogether."
entries.menuText: "I stand in agreement with Mr. Ricter. The vetoes should be removed."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""This is one of the starting points..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is one of the starting points of the whole discussion about changing the constitution."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Whatever you decide it's important..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you decide it's important to get a balanced picture. We will be making history by changing the '29 Constitution of Soll."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Most of their support is necessary..."
entries.dialogueText: "Most of their support is necessary to be able to amend the Constitution. And there is only one person who is key to make them back us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked sceptical."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked sceptical.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Gloria Tory. She's well respected..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gloria Tory. She's well respected by the Sollists. She'll be our biggest obstacle in the Assembly and her demands will be extensive."
